# Tuwa

> Tuwa is an iOS app for self-coached amateur competitive basketball players who strength-train seriously. The athlete authors their own training plan; Tuwa fuses that plan with HealthKit physiology, training history, soreness, match tier, and match proximity to suggest a daily go, modify, or hold verdict with an adjusted top-set number and a one-line reason. Tuwa does not write the program and is not a chat coach.

## Core concepts
- Strike zone: the daily training-intensity band that moves with physiology, training history, soreness, and basketball context.
- Daily verdict: a practical go, modify, or hold suggestion for the athlete's planned strength session.
- Microdose: trimming the athlete's own planned lift to one or two capped top sets near game day.
- Match proximity: when a game is within 48 hours, Tuwa protects freshness with capped top sets and skipped back-off work.
- ACWR (acute:chronic workload ratio): compares recent training load against a longer baseline. Tuwa treats it as workload context, not injury prediction.
- On-device privacy: raw HealthKit data stays on-device.

## Features
- [Daily Verdict](https://tuwa.app/features/recovery-scoring): go, modify, or hold suggestion with an adjusted top-set number and reason.
- [Lift + Match Logging](https://tuwa.app/features/workload-tracking): sets, reps, load, RPE, RIR, match tier, and cross-modal fatigue context.
- [Your Plan Input](https://tuwa.app/features/smart-templates): the athlete's own planned session with targets, caps, notes, and top-set intent.
- [Cold-Start Onboarding](https://tuwa.app/features/cold-start): useful guidance from day one, no baseline wait.
- [Back-Room Review](https://tuwa.app/training-load): workload, recovery, match proximity, and progress review.

## Topics
- [Methodology](https://tuwa.app/methodology): the science behind Tuwa's readiness and load models.

- [Readiness Score](https://tuwa.app/readiness-score): how the daily readiness score is calculated.
- [Compare](https://tuwa.app/compare): how Tuwa differs from wearable scores, AI coaches, and planning tools.

## SEO/GEO pages
- [Strength Readiness Calculator](https://tuwa.app/strength-readiness-calculator): free tool that suggests whether to go, modify, or hold.
- [Apple Watch Training Load for Lifters](https://tuwa.app/apple-watch-training-load-for-lifters): guide to combining Apple Watch load with sets, reps, RPE, soreness, and workout history.
- [How to Adjust Training When HRV Is Low](https://tuwa.app/guides/how-to-adjust-training-when-hrv-is-low): practical low-HRV strength training decision tree.
- [HRV for Strength Training](https://tuwa.app/guides/hrv-for-strength-training): explains how lifters should use HRV with recovery and local fatigue context.
- [Training Load vs Recovery](https://tuwa.app/guides/training-load-vs-recovery): explains workload, recovery, and session adjustment.
- [ACWR Explained](https://tuwa.app/guides/acwr-explained): explains acute:chronic workload ratio with limitations.
- [RPE-Based Volume Adjustment](https://tuwa.app/guides/rpe-volume-adjustment): shows how to adjust sets, reps, and load from RPE.
- [Weekly Training Review Template](https://tuwa.app/weekly-training-review-template): review framework for workload, recovery, soreness, and next-week changes.
